$help: Windows Terminal fragment for recording the demo. Adds one profile and changes no existing one. Install: copy this file to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows Terminal\Fragments\SlackSmith\. Remove: delete that folder. Why it exists: at the default 12pt font this 1920x1080, 125%-scaled screen gives 157 columns, measured 2026-09-13, and beat 8's table needs 162 (demo/PHASE1_CUT.md finding 4). Background and foreground match demo/remotion/src/facts.ts so the terminal and the two cards read as one video.
